title: Owned Optimizely shopper consent and caller compatibility
scope: Guard retained shopper Optimizely tracking and decisions with existing tenant-owned capability and strict durable false-only consent before any Optimizely initialization, evaluation or dispatch; update the owned storefront lane and two examples to that contract.
non_goals: Partial W05/F05/F10/N06/N11/N12 only. Keep provider webhooks, preview/datafile/banner behavior separate: no invented sender-to-shopper trust or automatic integration removal. D01/D03/D06 and global absent-state, necessary-record retention, privacy/customer/release decisions remain pending.

No shared consent/SDK/service/scorer/DO algorithm changes, new protocol, identity bootstrap, infrastructure or broad test programme. Legacy storefront metric has no owned lane and is explicitly unavailable as temporary unauthorized-path containment, not claimed integration parity. Reuse valid unchanged interfaces, not historical whole-task acceptance.
No stage/commit/push/deploy/cloud/resources/credentials/customer-data/destructive/unrelated operations; root alone owns records and acceptance, worker no subdelegation.

criteria.description: Only /optimizely/track and /decisions require current provisioned-tenant shopper capability; canonical body userId must match before owned-state reads. Strict optional boolean consent hints and false cookies can only restrict stored consent; persist necessary refusal before success/effects. Invalid, unavailable, malformed, forwarded or recognized-missing owned state fails closed with SessionAccessError preserved, no Optimizely fallback; existing anonymous absent-state compatibility remains. Tracking false returns explicit skipped/tracked:false/tracking_refused and consent with zero service initialization/cache/evaluation/dispatch. Decisions with either switch false return requested experiment keys null, feature keys {enabled:false,variables:{}}, segments:[], explicit default/refusal metadata and consent without service construction or evaluation; own-key-safe maps, never mock control. Tracking-only measurement remains allowed; allowed shape/attributes/tags and optional JWT behavior remain compatible. Recheck target after awaits before permitted service operation; per-request snapshot, not atomic revocation.

Storefront trackXsurf collects behavior tags only inside current SDK core.capture, uses live canonical visitorId, current owned headers/tenant and configured URL, and initiates metric fetch synchronously inside the gated callback with final current/tracking guard, not generic postJson readiness gap or stale anonId. Readiness withdrawal/identity change drops stale capture; no refusal-side metric/tag reads. Legacy non-SDK lane explicitly skips unavailable metric without new identity bootstrap or unrelated transport changes. Two Optimizely examples and short API contract show current owned credentials, false-only hints and refusal defaults; consenting calls still work and errors/defaults are handled.

Extend only existing two route/boundary suites with both hosts, switch combinations, ownership/unknown/error cases, refusal persistence, default keys and positive controls; retain actual service initialize/cache/fetch dispatcher positive proof with synthetic SDK-creation seam explicitly labeled. Worker fixed K1, app noEmit, JS syntax, actual storefront-method/core in-memory smoke and scoped diff. Independent exact K1 once plus caller smoke, actual before/final source/full proof and relevant local import graph/pins review. Preserve exact W05.06 acceptance historically before shared fixture overlap and qualify its proof; no whole-task reacceptance, SDK rebuild or deployed/native/runtime/performance/customer acceptance.
